task: Chess rules engine ae.chess verified against published perft counts
reasoning_summary: Mutable board with make/unmake returning an Undo record; legal moves are pseudo-legal moves filtered by king safety, with castling and en passant special-cased. Perft against the six standard positions (plus colour-mirrored versions) is the objective oracle, backed by random-playout round trips, SAN round trips and negamax versus alpha-beta differential tests. Two runs were needed: the first failed only on wrong hand-written test fixtures.
